You do not need one. The wallet, ingestion, .tkpak files and passing tickets to another phone on the same Wi-Fi all work with no server. A server adds a place for the log to meet devices that are not in the room, and an authority that can settle a contested claim.
Without http:// or https://, https is used.
Enter the code that was emailed to you.
Enter the code from your authenticator app.

The vault passphrase is not your sign-in password. The password proves who you are; the passphrase decrypts your tickets, and the server keeps it nowhere. That is why it is asked for on every connection.
Connected. Syncing exchanges the operation log in both directions.
